en: A black‑and‑white view of a two‑story villa or manor house with a steep tiled roof, twin chimneys, arched windows with brick surrounds, and an ornate central gable. A wooden portico supported by brick columns shelters the main entrance. Ivy climbs the facade and small conifer trees and other greenery surround the cobblestone driveway in front. The overall setting appears to be a rural or semi‑rural estate.
